headline: Marban Hollow Flares as Expanse Fight Grinds On
war_summary: Since the 1806 edition Marban Hollow has surged to the front with five changes in two hours, twenty-four on the day about Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall for two Warden, three Colonial and three destroyed holdings, latest at the 2106 wire, while the Weathered Expanse remains the heaviest sector with seven in two hours, fifty-four on the day about Crow's Nest, Spirit Watch and Necropolis for four Warden, one Colonial and four destroyed, last at 2016. Linn Mercy has rekindled with four in two hours, twenty-two on the day about Outwich Ranch and Lathair for ten Colonial and one destroyed, also last at 2016, and Mooring County shows four in two hours, eight on the day about the Wind Hills for twelve Warden holdings, latest at 2106. Nevish Line has cooled to two in two hours, twenty-seven on the day about Princefal and Blackcoat Way for eight Warden holdings, last at 1919. Stonecradle, Kuura Strand and Stlican Shelf logged nothing in two hours, while Callahan's Passage reports 7,118 Colonial and 5,323 Warden casualties on the day with no recorded transfer.
